policy.strictSiteIdentity: Every group must map exact UK ChargePoint PCPR locationId and source station name, city and connector count. Site-level evidence is not exact EVSE verification unless power and provider corroborate.
policy.publicDefinition: UK Public Charge Point Regulations permit public use in hotel/customer premises even when hours or parking fees apply, but exclusive workforce/residents points are not public.
policy.categoryMeaning: public_venue* confirms customer/visitor access under listed conditions; workplace_likely_nonpublic and operator_site_policy_conflict remain quarantined, not falsely resolved; nonpublic_venue_policy excludes from public price ranking until exact exception evidence.
